advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Raise the anti-vacuity floor to 18 (or assert heredoc and quoted counts separately) so a silent break of the quoted-description regex fails the test instead of passing at measured==15.
evidence: tests/unit/test_alarm_actions_terraform.py:475: comment `The tree has 15 heredoc and 3 quoted descriptions today.`

tests/unit/test_alarm_actions_terraform.py:460-463: quoted-form blocks that fail to match fall through to `continue`, so a broken quoted regex is invisible while measured==15 still satisfies the floor
advisory.finding: The anti-vacuity floor `assert measured >= 15` is set to the heredoc count alone, not the total (18). If the quoted-description regex silently stops matching (regex slip or HCL reformat of the 3 quoted alarms in monitoring.tf), those 3 blocks hit the `else: continue` branch, `measured` stays at 15, and the guard passes having stopped measuring exactly the quoted forms it was added to cover — the same vacuous-pass failure mode the floor exists to prevent.
scenarios: A future reformat converts one quoted alarm's punctuation such that `_QUOTED_DESCRIPTION_RE` no longer matches
A regex edit to _QUOTED_DESCRIPTION_RE breaks it while _HEREDOC_DESCRIPTION_RE still matches all 15
advisory.suggested_fix: Track heredoc and quoted matches separately and assert each against its own floor (e.g. `assert heredoc_measured >= 15` and `assert quoted_measured >= 3`), or at minimum change the combined floor to `>= 18`.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a positive test that an over-1024-character description (both heredoc and quoted forms) is detected by the guard's length/dedent logic.
evidence: tests/unit/test_alarm_actions_terraform.py:465 `if len(rendered) > _AWS_ALARM_DESCRIPTION_MAX:` — this branch is never taken by any test input; all 18 committed descriptions are under 1024

Sibling guards each have a positive rejection test: test_the_flap_guard_rejects_a_single_datapoint_latch (line 391), test_opt_out_marker_requires_a_reason (line 292), test_masking_ignores_prose_mentions_of_alarm_actions (line 277)
ABSENCE: no assertion drives an over-1024 heredoc or quoted body through _rendered_description/_QUOTED_DESCRIPTION_RE to confirm it lands in too_long
advisory.finding: The new guard has no test that a >1024-character description is actually flagged; the rejection branch (too_long append + dedent/length computation) is never exercised, so a bug in _rendered_description or the length comparison would pass silently against the all-under-cap committed tree — the same regression-blindness that let the original 1180-char defect through.
scenarios: A refactor breaks textwrap.dedent handling or flips the comparison operator; the test stays green because no committed description trips the branch
A quoted-body regex change under-captures the string length; over-long quoted descriptions would no longer be flagged
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a unit test that constructs a synthetic alarm block with a heredoc body >1024 chars after dedent and a quoted body >1024 chars, runs the same _HEREDOC_DESCRIPTION_RE/_QUOTED_DESCRIPTION_RE + _rendered_description path, and asserts len(rendered) > _AWS_ALARM_DESCRIPTION_MAX for each.

evidence: tests/unit/test_alarm_actions_terraform.py:475 comment: `The tree has 15 heredoc and 3 quoted descriptions today.`
Confirmed 18 total: 15 heredoc across monitoring/1fa8/88ab/9ea3/autodeploy(4)/bridge/eb6e/foxterrier(2)/s4b/s5/ws7 plus 3 quoted at monitoring.tf:120,146,219
advisory.finding: The anti-vacuity floor (measured >= 15) is below the actual count of 18 descriptions (15 heredoc + 3 quoted), so all three QUOTED descriptions — the form this diff added _QUOTED_DESCRIPTION_RE to cover — can silently stop matching and the floor still passes, leaving the newly-added quoted-form coverage unprotected against the exact vacuity the floor exists to prevent.
scenarios: A slip in _QUOTED_DESCRIPTION_RE drops all three quoted descriptions; measured falls to 15 and the floor still passes, so the quoted alarms (including gerrit_data_disk_high) go unmeasured against the 1024 cap
